name: MARS AdvantageKit Bridge
author: STZ-Robotics
description: Bridges every MARS ModularSubsystem's input snapshots into AdvantageKit's logging and replay pipeline, reusing ForgeMini's reflection-based field/struct serialization convention. Also mirrors MARS diagnostics as AdvantageKit outputs and ships a LoggedRobot base wired to the MARS RunMode. No changes required to existing IO interfaces or Data classes.
